grammar_focus: 比较级和最高级(规则-er/-est · 拼写去e/双写/变y · 多音节more/most · 不规则good-better-best/bad-worse-worst/many-more-most · 比较级+than · the+最高级+in · more+名词)
scene: 乔的花园全镇最美、年年获奖;比尔的更大更勤;而'我'总因最差的花园得个小奖

grammar_card.title: 比一比:更…、最…(比较级和最高级)
grammar_card.intro: 本课讲怎么说'更…'(比较级)和'最…'(最高级)。全用本课句子举例。

rows: 短词:加 -er(更…)/ 加 -est(最…);去e:large→larger;双写:big→bigger;变y:pretty→prettiest
Bill's garden is bigger than Joe's.
长词(两个以上音节):前面加 more(更…)/ most(最…),不加 -er/-est
Joe's garden is more interesting. / the most beautiful garden
I win a prize for the worst garden.
比较级 + than(比…);the + 最高级 + in/of(在…中最…)
Bill works harder than Joe. / the most beautiful garden in town

specialRules.rule: more 也能直接加名词,表示'更多的':more flowers = 更多的花
副词也有比较级:works harder(干得更卖力)/ runs faster(跑得更快)

prelisten.q: Listen and answer — Whose garden is the most beautiful in town?

passage: Joe Sanders has the most beautiful garden in our whole town. Joe's garden is my favorite of all. Every year, almost everyone enters for the "Nicest Garden Competition." But Joe wins the prize every single time. Bill Frith's garden is bigger than Joe's, and Bill works much harder. He also grows more flowers and colorful vegetables. But Joe's garden is more interesting than Bill's. Joe has made the neatest paths and built a wooden bridge over a small pool. His garden is only ten meters wide, but it is the prettiest one around. I love gardens too, but I do not like hard work. Each year I enter for the competition as well, and I always win a little prize for the worst garden in town!
